scope: Study-derived families for the 149 published repaired causes. This revision documents existing labels; it does not recode them.
initial_basis: TEB dimensions, open native-system coding, and repair semantics; archived root-cause codebook v2 and cohort extension v3.
normalization_rule: Group native concepts by their causal role at the first invalid decision, retaining the native description and source evidence.
primary_rule: Choose the condition whose violation first permits the effect. Preserve later mechanisms without counting them as primary.
secondary_rule: Use only obligations selected by both recorded passes, excluding the primary obligation, for compound analysis.
freeze_policy: This documentation snapshot is versioned separately from archived A/B labels. Earlier files preserve vocabularies and reconciled assignments but do not establish a complete definition freeze before comparison. Any future semantic definition change requires a new version, recoding and recomputed agreement and RQ tables.

logical value--storage content.definition: The logical value is represented by the current bytes or initialized state of storage.
logical value--storage content.inclusion_rule: Content initialization or updates determine validity.
logical value--storage content.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use content for which bytes must be present; use layout for where elements reside.
logical value--storage content.tie_breaking_rule: Use content for which bytes must be present; use layout for where elements reside.

positive_example.native_relation: The caching allocator binds a logical parameter and initial_data to a free-pool HAL buffer.
positive_example.root_cause: The old caching allocator treated a matching reusable allocation as initialized even when initial_data was supplied.
positive_example.repair: Commit 7be84611 writes initial_data into an existing buffer, checks the write status, and returns the buffer only after successful initialization.

operation--completion.definition: An operation is related to its readiness, completion, or dependency state.
operation--completion.inclusion_rule: The operation must wait, finish, or make progress before another action.
operation--completion.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use completion for execution readiness; use lifetime for keeping the resource alive.
operation--completion.tie_breaking_rule: Use completion for execution readiness; use lifetime for keeping the resource alive.

positive_example.native_relation: The tensor-core strategy binds loop iterations, async copies, shared-memory stages, and mma.sync consumers.
positive_example.root_cause: The old strategy allowed a pipeline schedule after multibuffering failed to separate every participating shared-memory operand.
positive_example.repair: PR 13971 makes the mma.sync schedule explicit, rejects incomplete scheduling ingredients, strengthens strategy validation, and adds conservative size and depth guards.

operation--execution context.definition: An operation is bound to a device, backend, stream, or execution configuration.
operation--execution context.inclusion_rule: The consuming decision selects or uses an execution environment.
operation--execution context.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use context for where or under which configuration execution occurs; identity for which logical entity is selected.
operation--execution context.tie_breaking_rule: Use context for where or under which configuration execution occurs; identity for which logical entity is selected.

positive_example.native_relation: LLVMCPU linking binds generated math calls to embedded or externally supplied implementations.
positive_example.root_cause: LLVMCPUTarget linked the musl module independently of the user's linkEmbedded setting.
positive_example.repair: PR 14246 places musl bitcode linking under options_.linkEmbedded, leaving those symbols for the external static link when the option is false.

storage--ownership/lifetime.definition: Storage or an associated resource is linked to owners, references, and its valid lifetime.
storage--ownership/lifetime.inclusion_rule: Retain, release, donation, or reclamation controls legal use.
storage--ownership/lifetime.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use lifetime for continued validity of a resource; shared storage for aliasing between observable values.
storage--ownership/lifetime.tie_breaking_rule: Use lifetime for continued validity of a resource; shared storage for aliasing between observable values.

positive_example.native_relation: The task poller binds an execution wait to its list membership until completion retirement.
positive_example.root_cause: The old poller retired the wait task before removing it from the poller's working set and wait list.
positive_example.repair: PR 11352 returns the retire status to the caller, erases the task from the wait list, retires it afterward, and clears the now-invalid local pointer.

value--operation/identity.definition: A logical value, argument, or resource role corresponds to a concrete operation or slot.
value--operation/identity.inclusion_rule: The decision selects the entity or argument position serving a logical role.
value--operation/identity.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use identity for which entity or slot; storage/layout for an element address or view within storage.
value--operation/identity.tie_breaking_rule: Use identity for which entity or slot; storage/layout for an element address or view within storage.

positive_example.native_relation: Each pipeline set position refers either to the active bound resources or to an empty placeholder needed only to preserve set numbering.
positive_example.root_cause: BuiltinExecutables created every placeholder with binding count one, and native layout creation enabled the push-descriptor flag independently of whether a set had real bindings.
positive_example.repair: PR 10448 creates dummy layouts with zero bindings and enables the push-descriptor flag only when a layout contains at least one binding.

value--representation.definition: A value is related to its type, precision, encoding, or lowered carrier.
value--representation.inclusion_rule: Conversion or metadata determines how a value is represented.
value--representation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use representation for meaning of encoded values; layout for their arrangement in storage.
value--representation.tie_breaking_rule: Use representation for meaning of encoded values; layout for their arrangement in storage.

positive_example.native_relation: Arith-to-SPIR-V conversion binds a logical sub-byte integer to a wider legal SPIR-V carrier and its extension semantics.
positive_example.root_cause: The conversion treated equal converted carrier types as if no semantic extension or truncation remained necessary.
positive_example.repair: LLVM commit 2b066501 adds masking and logical/arithmetic shifts for emulated integer extension and truncation. Commit 69a3c9cd permits sub-byte vector conversion. IREE PR 14652 imports them and adds the reported ui4-to-f32 end-to-end regression.

value--shared storage.definition: Distinct values or operations share storage through aliasing, reuse, or mutation.
value--shared storage.inclusion_rule: Validity depends on whether another observable value shares the selected storage.
value--shared storage.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Use sharing for interference between values; lifetime for resource validity through last use.
value--shared storage.tie_breaking_rule: Use sharing for interference between values; lifetime for resource validity through last use.

positive_example.native_relation: The update connects the computed value to an externally supplied target that may be tied to another value.
positive_example.root_cause: The folder used type/extent equality as sufficient evidence for folding without proving value semantics.
positive_example.repair: The fold now requires hasValueSemantics(target), excluding external, tied, and subview resources.

value--storage/layout.definition: Logical elements correspond to storage positions, shapes, strides, or offsets.

value--storage/layout.tie_breaking_rule: Use layout for position and arrangement; representation for numerical or type encoding.

positive_example.native_relation: A binding number and byte offset jointly identify the physical subspan passed to each microkernel argument.
positive_example.root_cause: The memref representation treated a nonzero binding-subspan offset as if the memref began at offset zero on a backend without pointer-arithmetic lowering.
positive_example.repair: PR 12510 represents nonzero subspan offsets in strided memref metadata, preserves them during flattening, wires the passes into affected backends, and adds offset-sensitive tests.

omitted operation.inclusion_rule: A write, copy, conversion, retain, or release is not performed.
omitted operation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose omitted operation for absent action; lost relation for information dropped before a later action.
omitted operation.tie_breaking_rule: Choose omitted operation for absent action; lost relation for information dropped before a later action.

positive_example.native_relation: The caching allocator binds a logical parameter and initial_data to a free-pool HAL buffer.
positive_example.root_cause: The old caching allocator treated a matching reusable allocation as initialized even when initial_data was supplied.
positive_example.repair: Commit 7be84611 writes initial_data into an existing buffer, checks the write status, and returns the buffer only after successful initialization.

premature invalidation or stale state.definition: A recorded relation is invalidated before last use or remains cached after its source changes.
premature invalidation or stale state.inclusion_rule: A consumer uses a stale relation or a relation removed too early.
premature invalidation or stale state.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose stale state when validity of a recorded relation is primary; premature transition when the action's event order is primary.
premature invalidation or stale state.tie_breaking_rule: Choose stale state when validity of a recorded relation is primary; premature transition when the action's event order is primary.

positive_example.native_relation: The bytecode dispatcher binds encoded register ordinals to storage in the current VM stack frame.
positive_example.root_cause: The variadic-import path resumed dispatch without refreshing its cached register pointers.
positive_example.repair: PR 12809 restores regs_i32, regs_ref, and pc after every bytecode or import call that may have changed the stack.

premature or unordered transition.definition: A transition occurs before a represented predecessor or completion condition is satisfied.
premature or unordered transition.inclusion_rule: Temporal state exists but an action executes too early.
premature or unordered transition.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose premature transition when the mechanism represents the temporal state; missing enforcement when no required edge is present.
premature or unordered transition.tie_breaking_rule: Choose premature transition when the mechanism represents the temporal state; missing enforcement when no required edge is present.

positive_example.native_relation: The task poller binds an execution wait to its list membership until completion retirement.
positive_example.root_cause: The old poller retired the wait task before removing it from the poller's working set and wait list.
positive_example.repair: PR 11352 returns the retire status to the caller, erases the task from the wait list, retires it afterward, and clears the now-invalid local pointer.

unsound assumption or inference.definition: A decision derives a semantic property from premises that do not entail it.
unsound assumption or inference.inclusion_rule: A checked property is treated as sufficient for a different semantic property.
unsound assumption or inference.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose inference for an unjustified semantic conclusion; mapping for a wrong correspondence computed from a present fact.
unsound assumption or inference.tie_breaking_rule: Choose inference for an unjustified semantic conclusion; mapping for a wrong correspondence computed from a present fact.

positive_example.native_relation: Dispatch result position implicitly determines its associated read-write resource position.
positive_example.root_cause: EmplaceAllocations allowed non-prefix sparse emplacement even though the downstream representation relies on implicit ordering.
positive_example.repair: The pass stops emplacement at the first unemplaceable result, preserving a contiguous result prefix.

constrain unsafe transformation.definition: The fix restricts or disables a transformation or execution path to a sound domain.
constrain unsafe transformation.inclusion_rule: The semantic change narrows which transformations or paths are permitted.
constrain unsafe transformation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose constraint when behavior is removed or restricted as the repair; stronger check when an explicit required predicate is added to retain safe cases.
constrain unsafe transformation.tie_breaking_rule: Choose constraint when behavior is removed or restricted as the repair; stronger check when an explicit required predicate is added to retain safe cases.

positive_example.native_relation: LLVMCPU linking binds generated math calls to embedded or externally supplied implementations.
positive_example.root_cause: LLVMCPUTarget linked the musl module independently of the user's linkEmbedded setting.
positive_example.repair: PR 14246 places musl bitcode linking under options_.linkEmbedded, leaving those symbols for the external static link when the option is false.

correct mapping or representation.definition: The fix corrects a correspondence, target, index, offset, layout, or encoding.
correct mapping or representation.inclusion_rule: The semantic edit changes how an available fact maps to its concrete representation.
correct mapping or representation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose mapping for a corrected correspondence; propagation when the upstream fact was already correct but was lost before use.
correct mapping or representation.tie_breaking_rule: Choose mapping for a corrected correspondence; propagation when the upstream fact was already correct but was lost before use.

positive_example.native_relation: Each pipeline set position refers either to the active bound resources or to an empty placeholder needed only to preserve set numbering.
positive_example.root_cause: BuiltinExecutables created every placeholder with binding count one, and native layout creation enabled the push-descriptor flag independently of whether a set had real bindings.
positive_example.repair: PR 10448 creates dummy layouts with zero bindings and enables the push-descriptor flag only when a layout contains at least one binding.

correct ownership or lifetime.definition: The fix restores owners, references, or release eligibility through last use.
correct ownership or lifetime.inclusion_rule: The repair changes ownership transfer, retain/release, or reclamation behavior.
correct ownership or lifetime.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose lifetime for resource validity and release; ordering when the semantic edit orders events independently of ownership.
correct ownership or lifetime.tie_breaking_rule: Choose lifetime for resource validity and release; ordering when the semantic edit orders events independently of ownership.

positive_example.native_relation: The task poller binds an execution wait to its list membership until completion retirement.
positive_example.root_cause: The old poller retired the wait task before removing it from the poller's working set and wait list.
positive_example.repair: PR 11352 returns the retire status to the caller, erases the task from the wait list, retires it afterward, and clears the now-invalid local pointer.

perform omitted operation.definition: The fix executes a previously missing required action.
perform omitted operation.inclusion_rule: A write, copy, conversion, or other concrete operation is newly performed.
perform omitted operation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose operation for supplying the action itself; propagation for carrying information needed by an existing consumer.
perform omitted operation.tie_breaking_rule: Choose operation for supplying the action itself; propagation for carrying information needed by an existing consumer.

positive_example.root_cause: The old caching allocator treated a matching reusable allocation as initialized even when initial_data was supplied.
positive_example.repair: Commit 7be84611 writes initial_data into an existing buffer, checks the write status, and returns the buffer only after successful initialization.

preserve or propagate relation.definition: The fix carries an already-correct upstream fact to its consumer.
preserve or propagate relation.inclusion_rule: A policy, relation, metadata field, or dependency is retained across a boundary.
preserve or propagate relation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose propagation for restoring transmission; mapping when the transmitted fact must instead be translated differently.
preserve or propagate relation.tie_breaking_rule: Choose propagation for restoring transmission; mapping when the transmitted fact must instead be translated differently.

positive_example.native_relation: A binding number and byte offset jointly identify the physical subspan passed to each microkernel argument.
positive_example.root_cause: The memref representation treated a nonzero binding-subspan offset as if the memref began at offset zero on a backend without pointer-arithmetic lowering.
positive_example.repair: PR 12510 represents nonzero subspan offsets in strided memref metadata, preserves them during flattening, wires the passes into affected backends, and adds offset-sensitive tests.

restore ordering or synchronization.definition: The fix establishes or repairs a dependency, wait, notification, barrier, or completion protocol.
restore ordering or synchronization.inclusion_rule: The semantic repair restores relative event order or progress.
restore ordering or synchronization.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose ordering for execution protocol; lifetime when ownership or reference validity is the changed condition.
restore ordering or synchronization.tie_breaking_rule: Choose ordering for execution protocol; lifetime when ownership or reference validity is the changed condition.

positive_example.native_relation: pending_queue_actions binds an action's lifetime across worker execution and CUDA/HIP host callbacks.
positive_example.root_cause: Worker liveness tracked only immediately visible ready work, not actions executing through host callbacks.
positive_example.repair: PR 16621 counts pending actions until cleanup, posts the state notification from callbacks, delays worker exit until the count is zero, and mirrors the protocol in HIP.

strengthen eligibility check.definition: The fix adds or strengthens a predicate governing a potentially invalid decision.
strengthen eligibility check.inclusion_rule: Safe cases remain eligible after checking the previously omitted condition.
strengthen eligibility check.exclusion_rule: Exclude the competing case according to this boundary: Choose stronger check for explicit validation; constraint when the transformation or path is restricted without that validation.
strengthen eligibility check.tie_breaking_rule: Choose stronger check for explicit validation; constraint when the transformation or path is restricted without that validation.

positive_example.native_relation: The tensor-core strategy binds loop iterations, async copies, shared-memory stages, and mma.sync consumers.
positive_example.root_cause: The old strategy allowed a pipeline schedule after multibuffering failed to separate every participating shared-memory operand.
positive_example.repair: PR 13971 makes the mma.sync schedule explicit, rejects incomplete scheduling ingredients, strengthens strategy validation, and adds conservative size and depth guards.
